cases.name: Heidi Lynn White
cases.about: She was from St. Paul, MN and worked at Costco. Her obituary said, "Heidi loved fishing, being with friends, and was always ready for a themed party. Halloween was top on the list!" and KIm Y. wrote: "Heidi was one of the first people I had the pleasure to meet at Costco . She never passed by anyone without saying "hi" and with a genuine smile! As she came through self-check out with her little purchases, she always had a story to share. By the end of her shift, you could always tell how hard she had worked. I'll never forget the woman I got to know with the "golden locks" (always with "sides-up"), often a skort, and those unforgettable "Timberlands! Heidi, Heaven is lucky to have you, but you will be forever missed here on Earth."
cases.narrative: He allegedly ran her over with his truck in the parking lot of a Holiday Station Store gas station.
